name: in.vynix/vynix-mcp
title: Vynix
description: Give AI coding agents access to your Vynix visual feedback, bug reports, and AI diagnosis.

environmentVariables.name: VYNIX_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Vynix API base URL. Defaults to https://www.vynix.in.

environmentVariables.name: VYNIX_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal access token generated at https://www.vynix.in/mcp.

environmentVariables.name: VYNIX_API_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Optional login email for token refresh mode when token is not set.

environmentVariables.name: VYNIX_API_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Optional login password for token refresh mode when token is not set.
